headline: European bison return to Britain after 6,000 years
meta_description: A new herd of European bison is being reintroduced to 5,000 acres of protected British land to restore natural habitats.
summary_short: European bison, absent from Britain for millennia, are returning to restore ecosystems across newly protected land.
body:
European bison are returning to Britain for the first time in 6,000 years. A new herd is being reintroduced to 5,000 acres of protected land, where these giant mammals will play a crucial role in restoring natural habitats.

The reintroduction marks a significant milestone in rewilding efforts across the United Kingdom. By bringing these massive herbivores back to the landscape, conservationists hope to catalyze ecological restoration—bison naturally shape their environment through grazing and movement, helping to create diverse habitats for countless other species.

This project demonstrates how large-scale land protection and species reintroduction can work together to heal damaged ecosystems. The presence of bison will generate new opportunities for wildlife to thrive while reconnecting Britain with a lost chapter of its natural history.
quick_facts: European bison absent from Britain for 6,000 years
New herd reintroduced to 5,000 acres of protected land
Giant mammals restore natural habitats and create new homes
